time_and_host.deadline_scope: run_cost.py execute() starts its recorded stage/deadline only after source_snapshot(), admit_geometry() and, for measure, admit_build(). time_and_host.timed_interval_scope: steady_clock surrounds state resets/assignments, sentinel initialization, noinline/noipa/indirect wrappers, MEB work and result/Work capture. Fixture/job construction, fresh F rank pilots, full pre/post comparisons, expected digest construction, event capacity reserve, record formatting/writes and runner parsing are outside each timed group. The subprocess time includes the harness work and stdout; the receipt stage also includes runner judgments and closure.
time_and_host.clock: Minimum positive difference over a fixed diagnostic of 128 pairs is 30 ns; short_batch means elapsed<100*30 ns=3000 ns. This is a local diagnostic, not a calibrated precision or uncertainty guarantee. Every raw short batch remains present.
time_and_host.thread_environment: OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL/NUMEXPR set to 1; forbidden compiler/loader/sanitizer overrides empty; selected CPU metadata and affinity match before/after and original affinity restored.
time_and_host.shared_host_limit: Logical CPU affinity and a coordinated measurement window do not establish exclusive physical-core/cache/SMT or VM-host access. No contemporaneous co-tenant load, frequency, migration/steal-time or isolation trace is captured. No dedicated-hardware or independent-run confidence claim follows from seven within-process passes. No RSS, GPU or whole-CLI/tower timing is supplied by this receipt.

important_limits: During timing, equality uses deterministic 64-bit rolling terminal and Work captures. Those are checked against precomputed values and paired arms; they are not collision-free substitutes for full state comparison. Full named-field comparison occurs in the separate before/after runs.

The raw case q_result is null on resource refusal, while terminal hashing still includes the actual local ball sentinel/state. Printed ok/success denotes the helper boolean; the fixture deliberately seeds an invariant-violation status/reason and success preserves that seed. This is not a public product completion status.
actual_F_fallback_candidates is the legacy-charge delta when fallback is taken. fallback_unattributed deliberately avoids assigning causes not observable through these interfaces.
The F reference and proposal share arithmetic and fixtures. No independent full-u16 arithmetic proof, sanitizer campaign, CI/GPU/SLO or product performance gain is established.
The preparation README/header and preparation.json still describe their historical uncompiled/unmeasured stage. The later sealed build/measure receipts are the execution authority.

Elapsed group costs include capture overhead; no subtraction or reinterpretation as bare-helper cost is justified. Cost stratification and comparison analysis are maintained separately by the parent/index reviewer.
